label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows through replace("'", "''") into SQL string concatenation at line 24, then executes via executeQuery at line 25. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled (param with modified quotes). The apostrophe-doubling mitigation is insufficient - proper prevention requires parameterized queries, not string escaping. This is a known SQL injection vulnerability pattern.
